Text Description
This activity contains a set of dialog cards, which are described below.
 
Activity Description or Instruction: Berry names are presented in Spanish. You can turn the cards to see the correct English translations.
  1. Dialog Text: Fresas; Image Alt Text: Red berries with green leaves
  2. Dialog Text: Frambuesas; Image Alt Text: Red berries
  3. Dialog Text: Guindas; Image Alt Text: Red berries with green stems
  4. Dialog Text: Grosellas rojas; Image Alt Text: Small spherical red berries
  5. Dialog Text: Arándanos azules; Image Alt Text: Berries which have a blue colour
